notes.title: Zulin update
notes.notes: 60 fps lock is added. High fps gameplay had some bugs.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Mushroom effects works correctly on all levels now
- Starting game from zero after speedrun now works correctly
Thanks Cicerongamer for reporting about these bugs.

notes.title: "Pixel gun" update
notes.notes:
New secret level 

https://i.imgur.com/8pXpLBP.jpg


 Find the passage to the secret level on one of the normal levels.
 Meet a new character and play his crazy game.
 Complete the secret level to get a new achievement.


Steam inventory items

https://i.imgur.com/8gjYKk1.jpg


 Beat the game in any mode to get an inventory item (works 1 time per day)
 Exchange inventory items with other players
 Buy and sell items on the Steam Marketplace
 Use the received inventory items for more successful speedruns
 Use your patience to obtain the precious Ozon trophy


https://i.imgur.com/R3CJle0.jpg

Scary background music for all levels

 
 Someone confused this game with Unity indie horror? now you have real reasons for it.
